Immediate outreach recommended to offer remediation. - **Primary Outreach Contact:** `ventas@dpschile.cl` (`Verified`) ### Executive Overview & Pitch Angle This company currently scores **30/100** on automated WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility testing with **61 identified WCAG violations**.
